title: Mass Spec Sample Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs mass spec sample prep on up to 96 samples using an Opentrons thermocycler for incubation steps. Samples should be specified as comma-separated values on the first line of a `.csv` file, as in the following example: ``` A1,B1,C1,D1,E1,G1,B2 ``` The samples are filled according to the order of the `.csv`, and invalid wells are ignored (valid wells must be `A1`-`H12`) --- * [NEST 96-well PCR plate 100µL #402501](http://www.cell-nest.com/page94?_l=en&product_id=97&product_category=96) mounted in [Opentrons Thermocycler](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/thermocycler-module) * [NEST 1.5ml snapcap microcentrifuge tubes](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-consumables/products/nest-microcentrifuge-tubes) (or equivalent) mounted in [Opentrons 4-in-1 tuberack with 4x6 insert](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-labware/products/tube-rack-set-1) * [Opentrons P20 GEN2 electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Opentrons 10/20ul tiprack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) --- Opentrons 4-in-1 tuberack with 4x6 1.5ml tube insert * tube A1: enzyme * tube B1: reagent 1 * tube C1: reagent 2
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file whose first line lists the wells to process as comma‑separated values (e.g., A1,B1,C1,D1,E1,G1,B2). The protocol can handle up to 96 samples; only wells A1‑H12 are valid and any invalid entries will be ignored.

steps.title: Load required labware
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the Opentrons robot: a NEST 96‑well PCR plate (100 µL, catalog #402501) mounted in the Opentrons Thermocycler; NEST 1.5 mL snap‑cap microcentrifuge tubes (or equivalent) in a 4‑in‑1 tuberack with a 4×6 insert; an Opentrons P20 GEN2 electronic pipette; and an Opentrons 10/20 µL tiprack. Load the tube rack with tube A1 containing enzyme, tube B1 containing reagent 1, and tube C1 containing reagent 2.

steps.title: Upload CSV and set parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT App, upload the prepared .csv file, specify the mount side for the P50 single‑channel pipette, and enter the desired incubation temperature (in °C).

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Generate the Opentrons protocol based on the uploaded CSV and parameters, then download the resulting protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file back into the OT App for execution.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map, placing each piece of labware in its designated slot.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, perform calibration of the deck labware, tiprack, and the P20 GEN2 pipette (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the mass‑spec sample preparation workflow.
